name: shoptet-mcp
description: Shoptet MCP helps eshop administrators find and inspect orders, products, stock, customers, documents, coupons, reviews, and catalog settings, then perform scoped updates such as changing order status, adjusting inventory, managing products and categories, issuing coupons, and publishing blog content.
